im getting encoding errors / segfaults Caused by:
  In wgpuRenderPassEncoderEnd
    In a set_bind_group command
      Texture with 'effect' label has been destroyed
resolution: Encoding errors / segfault 'Texture with effect label has been destroyed' in wgpuRenderPassEncoderEnd set_bind_group. Root cause: a materialized face shader (effects.renderShaderToTexture) lives in the shared effects instance pool but is painted only ONCE at load; effects.update()'s idle sweep reaped it after STALE_INSTANCE_GRACE frames and destroyed its GPU texture, which a StaticSurface bind group keeps sampling for the whole run — so the next frame's set_bind_group referenced a dead texture. Only bit the engine-paint-loop path (dev host /compiled embedded route); the standalone loader never calls update(), which is why headless shots never reproduced it. Fix: exempt is_material instances from the reap sweep (load-once, freed only at cart teardown via deinitAll). Verified: world_loader + v8_app both rebuild clean ReleaseFast; standalone renders 3 textured batches, no regression.
